title: Remi's Quiet Meadow
tags: noise meter,classroom noise,quiet,voice level,sound level,calm,classroom management,teacher tool,red panda,brain break,class
description: A noise meter for the classroom: Remi the red panda naps in a meadow at sunset. If the class is too loud for too long, he wakes up, yawns and grumbles, then dozes off again once it is quiet. A clock counts the quiet time up to your goal. The device only measures how loud it is: nothing is recorded or saved. You can also try it without a microphone.
notes: Built on the Oomba Kit (pinned kit 1.1.3 tag, no packs): the kit's title, pause screen (Space, P, Esc or the pause button), settings (sound, less motion), results card, font, icons and light/dark look. A classroom noise meter: Remi, our own red panda (original art in the Oomba ink style: a hand-drawn SVG rig with blended poses, springy ears, tail and leaf scarf), naps in a meadow at sunset while the class keeps quiet. The microphone: the game never opens it. The play page of this one official game (server/services/mic-games.js: this slug, official, published) asks for it after the Start tap and passes the game one loudness number (dBFS) about 20 times a second through BRB.loudness; audio is never recorded, stored or sent, and the page stops the microphone on pause, a hidden page, leaving, a reload or its own Stop pill. Every other page answers 'off', and the game then offers its demo. The level maths, the room calibration and Remi's moods are window.RemiCore (pure ES5 between /* remi-core:begin */ and /* remi-core:end */; unit-tested): -70 dBFS is 0 on the gauge and -10 dBFS is 100; smoothing rises fast (0.12 s) and falls slowly (0.5 s); the 'too loud' line is the room's quiet (measured for 3 s with 'Set to the room's quiet', else 30) plus Whisper 10, Quiet work 18 or Group work 30, plus a fine slider of -25 to +25. Remi: asleep -> stirring (near the line: an ear twitch, a tail flick, one eye peeks, a murmur) -> waking after 1.5 s over the line (leaky, so a single clap only makes him stir): he sits up, stretches with a big yawn and grumbles 'Too loud!' -> grumpy (paws to his head while it is loud, arms crossed and a tapping foot when it is quieter, eyelids drooping as the room stays calm) -> after 4 s of calm he lies back down. The quiet-time clock runs only while he sleeps; the goal (2, 5, 10, 15, 20 or 30 min, or no goal) ends in a happy Remi with his arms wide, confetti and the results card (3 stars for 0-1 wake-ups, 2 for 2-3, 1 for more). His yawn, grumble, murmur and sigh are made with WebAudio in the frame, and the room is not listened to while they play (and 400 ms after). No mic (blocked, none, busy, an old browser, or a page that can't listen): a card says how to fix it, with Try again and 'Try it without a mic' (a noise slider, a clap and class chatter). Settings are remembered in BRB.storage key 'remis-quiet-meadow-v1' ({preset, fine, goal, base}: numbers and ids only). BRB.gameOver({won: true, score: null}) at the goal; no score, no poll, no text input. All words in 13 languages (the I18N block); Remi is Remi in every language. window.__brbTest: state/setup({preset, fine, goal, base})/closeSetup/demoStart/demo(on)/level(v)/setGoal(sec)/step(ms)/pose(name)/skipAnimations/calibrate(samples)/sounds/pause.

es.title: La pradera tranquila de Remi
es.description: Un medidor de ruido para la clase: Remi, un panda rojo, duerme la siesta en una pradera al atardecer. Si la clase hace demasiado ruido durante un rato, se despierta, bosteza y protesta, y vuelve a dormirse cuando hay silencio. Un reloj cuenta el tiempo de silencio hasta la meta. El dispositivo solo mide cuánto ruido hay: no se graba ni se guarda nada. También se puede probar sin micrófono.
es.tags: medidor de ruido,ruido en clase,silencio,volumen de voz,nivel de sonido,calma,gestión del aula,herramienta docente,panda rojo,pausa activa,clase

fr.title: La prairie calme de Remi
fr.description: Un sonomètre pour la classe : Remi, un panda roux, fait la sieste dans une prairie au coucher du soleil. Si la classe fait trop de bruit trop longtemps, il se réveille, bâille et râle, puis se rendort quand le calme revient. Une horloge compte le temps calme jusqu’à l’objectif. L’appareil mesure seulement le niveau de bruit : rien n’est enregistré ni gardé. On peut aussi l’essayer sans micro.
fr.tags: sonomètre,bruit en classe,calme,silence,niveau de voix,niveau sonore,gestion de classe,outil enseignant,panda roux,pause,classe

de.title: Remis stille Wiese
de.description: Eine Lärmampel für die Klasse: Remi, ein Roter Panda, macht auf einer Wiese im Abendlicht ein Nickerchen. Ist die Klasse zu lange zu laut, wacht er auf, gähnt und grummelt, und schläft wieder ein, wenn es still ist. Eine Uhr zählt die leise Zeit bis zum Ziel. Das Gerät misst nur, wie laut es ist: Nichts wird aufgenommen oder gespeichert. Es geht auch ohne Mikrofon.

it.title: Il prato tranquillo di Remi
it.description: Un misuratore di rumore per la classe: Remi, un panda rosso, fa un pisolino in un prato al tramonto. Se la classe fa troppo rumore troppo a lungo, si sveglia, sbadiglia e brontola, poi si riaddormenta quando torna il silenzio. Un orologio conta il tempo di silenzio fino all’obiettivo. Il dispositivo misura solo quanto rumore c’è: niente viene registrato o salvato. Si può provare anche senza microfono.
it.tags: misuratore di rumore,rumore in classe,silenzio,volume della voce,livello sonoro,calma,gestione della classe,strumento per docenti,panda rosso,pausa,classe

pt.title: O prado tranquilo do Remi
pt.description: Um medidor de barulho para a sala: o Remi, um panda-vermelho, tira uma soneca num prado ao pôr do sol. Se a turma faz barulho demais por muito tempo, ele acorda, boceja e resmunga, e volta a dormir quando tudo fica em silêncio. Um relógio conta o tempo de silêncio até a meta. O aparelho só mede o volume do barulho: nada é gravado nem salvo. Também dá para testar sem microfone.
pt.tags: medidor de barulho,barulho na sala,silêncio,volume da voz,nível de som,calma,gestão de sala,ferramenta do professor,panda-vermelho,pausa,turma

nl.title: Remi’s stille weide
nl.description: Een geluidsmeter voor de klas: Remi, een rode panda, doet een dutje in een weide bij zonsondergang. Is de klas te lang te druk, dan wordt hij wakker, gaapt en moppert, en slaapt weer in als het stil is. Een klok telt de stille tijd tot het doel. Het apparaat meet alleen hoe hard het is: er wordt niets opgenomen of bewaard. Je kunt het ook zonder microfoon proberen.

ru.title: Тихий луг Remi
ru.description: Шумомер для класса: Remi, малая панда, дремлет на лугу на закате. Если в классе слишком долго шумно, он просыпается, зевает и ворчит, а потом снова засыпает, когда становится тихо. Часы считают тихое время до цели. Устройство измеряет только громкость: ничего не записывается и не сохраняется. Можно попробовать и без микрофона.
ru.tags: шумомер,шум в классе,тишина,громкость голоса,уровень звука,спокойствие,управление классом,инструмент учителя,малая панда,перерыв,класс

ja.title: Remiのしずかな草原
ja.description: 教室の音量メーター：レッサーパンダのRemiが夕暮れの草原でお昼寝中。クラスがうるさい状態が続くと、Remiは起きてあくびをして文句を言い、しずかになるとまた眠ります。時計が目標までのしずかな時間を数えます。端末は音の大きさだけを測ります。録音も保存もしません。マイクなしでもためせます。

zh-Hant.title: Remi的安靜草原
zh-Hant.description: 教室噪音計：小熊貓Remi在夕陽下的草原上睡午覺。如果全班太吵太久，牠會醒來、打哈欠、抱怨，等教室安靜後又睡著。時鐘會計算到目標為止的安靜時間。裝置只測量聲音有多大：不會錄音，也不會儲存。也可以不用麥克風試試看。

ar.title: مرج Remi الهادئ
ar.description: مقياس ضجيج للصف: Remi، باندا حمراء، يأخذ قيلولة في مرج عند الغروب. إذا بقي الصف صاخبًا مدة طويلة يستيقظ ويتثاءب ويتذمّر، ثم يعود إلى النوم عندما يهدأ المكان. ساعة تعدّ الوقت الهادئ حتى الهدف. الجهاز يقيس فقط مدى ارتفاع الصوت: لا يُسجَّل شيء ولا يُحفَظ. ويمكن التجربة بدون ميكروفون.

he.title: האחו השקט של Remi
he.description: מד רעש לכיתה: Remi, פנדה אדומה, נח באחו בשקיעה. אם בכיתה רועש מדי זמן רב, הוא מתעורר, מפהק ורוטן, ונרדם שוב כשחוזר השקט. שעון סופר את הזמן השקט עד היעד. המכשיר מודד רק כמה רועש: שום דבר לא מוקלט ולא נשמר. אפשר לנסות גם בלי מיקרופון.
